purpose: Implementation validation of sample-conditioned feature contributions and Monte Carlo variance correction; no outer evaluation or selected feature budget
permutation_design: Independent iid uniform permutations for each method and resampling game; duplicates allowed
utility: Equal-weight mean positive F1 across three utility validation folds; selected rows fixed within each fold across all coalitions
empty_utility: Selected-training class prior probability, threshold 0.5, tie predicts positive
variance: Across-B sample variance minus mean within-game marginal variance/M, clipped to zero
group_policy: 80% stratified row subsamples; within each subsample utility folds respect groups
